name: Independent-Kinetic Screened Preferred-Frame with Auxiliary Chi
claimed_mechanism: The architecture uses an auxiliary chi to realize the frozen mu(y)=1-e^-y MOND relation, while a separate vector A_mu carries the finite propagating mode with an independent canonical kinetic normalization. A multiplier s weights only the preferred-frame alpha coupling to u_mu, so the screened response alpha ~ e^-y is controlled in the coupling sector without altering the A_mu kinetic term. This directly attacks the P7 collision by separating the screened preferred-frame response from the propagating-mode kinetic normalization. The physical metric remains the only matter-coupled metric and G is not rescaled.
predicted_weak_field: In the galactic low-acceleration regime, chi realizes the frozen mu(y) and yields the expected MOND scaling of the effective acceleration. In high-density or strong-field regions, e^-y drives the preferred-frame alpha response to zero, suppressing preferred-frame violations and fifth-force-like effects. The A_mu mode retains a finite canonical kinetic normalization and a well-defined propagation speed, so the screened limit does not degenerate the propagating sector. Solar-system weak fields are therefore screened while galactic dynamics remain MONDian.
inequivalence_argument: This is not a coefficient tweak of any killed screened preferred-frame, khronon, or scalar-tensor architecture because the kinetic normalization is carried by an independent standard-kinetic vector A_mu, while the screened preferred-frame response is carried by a separate multiplier s that only weights the alpha coupling. The P7 collision is removed architecturally: alpha can scale as e^-y without forcing the propagating kinetic term to vanish, diverge, or inherit the same screened coupling. It preserves a single physical metric, minimal matter coupling, frozen mu(y), and no rescaling of G, so it is distinct from the listed dead classes.
